newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE ponders wheat future developments.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE ponders wheat future developments.

text.p: The London International Fiinancial Futures Exchange is looking at ways of giving its wheat contract a more pan-European appeal, its chief executive Daniel Hodson told Reuters.
But no conclusions had been reached. "All bets are still on," Hodson said.

The exchange had moved quickly to look at a number of strategic points after the September merger of LIFFE and the London Commodity Exchange, he said. "We have hit the ground running." Development of the wheat market was one of the points being considered.
One question under consideration was whether the exchange would develop a new contract independently, or move in alliance with the Chicago Board of Trade, Hodson said.
LIFFE's current wheat contract is based on the UK market, but Amsterdam's ATA and the MATIF in Paris have this year both launched futures contracts designed to have a Europe wide application.
Turnover in both contracts has been low.
